content: Stacking three-fold out-of-fold construction. EXACTLY THREE folds in a development dataset, exactly THREE training runs: run1 holds fold1 out and trains on folds2+3; run2 holds fold2 out and trains folds1+3; run3 holds fold3 out and trains folds1+2. Each run uses several base learners and predicts ONLY its own heldout fold. All heldout predictions are assembled in original row order into one 3-column OOF feature matrix; matrix and true-label column feed the meta learner. Draw precise train/holdout membership masks, original fold row matching using consistent shades. Test/deployment output is distinct from these training runs and has a small area to note refit rule; do not route training-set predictions into meta learner. No direct arrow from heldout labels to base learner training. Generous slots around the matrix and fold masks for clear labels.
prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL academic machine-learning mechanism diagram; choose a fresh composition yourself. External reference images are used ONLY to understand the relevant mechanism, NOT to copy their layout, typography, gradients or colors. Output entirely UNLABELLED PNG with transparent canvas. Draw NO text, letters, numerals, mathematical glyphs, pseudo text, watermark. Reserve clear label slots next to real mechanism objects and within empty processing nodes; leave roomy margins for actual Chinese labels later. Flat 2D technical illustration: thin neutral #4C4D4F connections, simple filled arrowheads with exact endpoints, no lines crossing unrelated nodes. White/open regions plus a FEW pale solid grouping regions, never a grid of decorative cards. Repeated same-semantic nodes use the same color and omit decorative icons consistently. Necessary tensors, sample tokens, trees, split diagrams are mechanism objects. Palette #7B95C6 blue, #49C2D9 cyan, #67A583 green, #F59C7C orange, #C85E62 rose, pale uniform 18–30% white-mixed tints. Every colored continuous shape has constant flat color. NO gradient, paper/canvas texture, wave, grain, clouding, stripes, gloss, shadows, halos, glow, 3D, perspective. Exactly follow dependencies described below, do not invent relations merely for symmetry.

generation_versions.prompt: Edit reference1 ONLY by replacing the colors with the muted palette below and rounding ordinary module rectangles. Preserve the EXACT original canvas, component positions, margins, scale, all shapes, all grids and their row/column counts, node counts, every connector, arrow direction and line endpoints. Do NOT redesign or reflow anything. Reference2 is ONLY the palette/reference finish; never copy its topology. Current figure is ensemble-stacking-oof, original canvas 1536×1024px. Main representations, networks, states, ordinary outputs and computation blocks should be blue; green only auxiliary inputs/alternate branch, yellow only gates/selection/position, red only loss/errors/gradient correction, purple only a needed additional category. Distinct classes retain distinguishable muted colors. Natural photographic examples and anatomy colors retain their scientific meaning. Do not add text or symbols that were not in the reference. Style: exact white opaque canvas; flat 2D technical drawing, no gradients, textures, shadows, pseudo text, numbers or letters. Rounded rectangle modules (6 px corner radius), neutral dark wires #556170. Blue priority #7188A3 with fill #E5EAF0 for the main mechanism; muted green #829C8B fill #E8EEE9 only secondary sources; muted yellow #B4A16F fill #F1ECDD for position/selection; muted red #A7787D fill #F0E5E6 only losses/errors, not the generic output; purple #9588A5 only a further category if needed. Most area white, fills pale and uniform. Draw all shapes, actual mechanism glyphs, matrices and connectors, leave labels empty for real-font typography.
